name: Register Student Account
preconditions: The student does not have an existing account on the platform.
trigger: The student initiates the registration process.

main_scenario.sentence: Student provides an email address and a password.
System validates the email address format and password strength.
System creates a new student account with the supplied credentials.
System stores the student's personal data in a location that resides within the country.
System confirms successful registration to the student.

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: email format is invalid or password does not meet strength criteria

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the provided information is invalid and requests correction.

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: the email address is already associated with an existing account

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the email is already registered and suggests using password recovery.

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: account creation fails due to an internal error

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the student of a temporary error and advises to retry later.

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: storage of personal data fails

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the student of a temporary error and aborts the registration.

success_guarantee: A student account exists with the provided email and password.
The student's personal data is stored within the country.
The student can authenticate using the registered credentials.
minimal_guarantee: No partial student account remains after a failed registration.
Any temporary data created during a failed attempt is discarded.
Personal data is never stored outside the country even in error conditions.
The system records the registration attempt without exposing personal data.

name: Login Student
preconditions: Student has a registered account in the system
trigger: Student initiates login by providing an email address and a password

main_scenario.sentence: Student submits email and password
System validates the credentials
System confirms successful authentication

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: the credentials are invalid

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that authentication failed

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: the system cannot process the authentication request

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student of a temporary error

success_guarantee: Student is authenticated and may access the personal workspace
minimal_guarantee: No authenticated session is created when authentication fails
Submitted password is not retained after processing

name: Search Lectures
preconditions: Student is registered in the system
Student is authenticated and logged in

main_scenario.sentence: Student provides search criteria describing interests
System retrieves matching lectures using the lecture listing service
System returns the lecture listing to the student within two seconds

extensions.label: 1a
extensions.condition: The provided search criteria are empty or malformed

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the student that valid search criteria are required

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: The lecture listing service cannot be accessed

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the student that the search cannot be performed at this time

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: The system does not generate the response within two seconds

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the student of the delay and provides any available results when ready

success_guarantee: The student receives a list of lectures that match the provided interests
minimal_guarantee: No lecture data is persisted as a result of a failed search
The system remains available throughout the interaction
All communications are handled in compliance with security policies
The system continues to operate while new features are released, satisfying FR21

name: View Lecture Details
trigger: Student selects a lecture from the lecture list

main_scenario.sentence: Student selects the lecture of interest
System retrieves the description, price, and metadata for the selected lecture
System presents the lecture description, price, and metadata to the student

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: the selected lecture does not exist

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the lecture cannot be found

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: the system encounters an error while retrieving lecture details

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the details cannot be displayed due to a temporary error

success_guarantee: Student has viewed the lecture description, price, and metadata
minimal_guarantee: No lecture data is altered
System remains available for other operations

name: Purchase and Enroll in Lecture
trigger: Student initiates purchase of a lecture

main_scenario.sentence: Student selects a lecture to purchase
System forwards the student's payment card information to the external payment provider for processing
System receives confirmation of successful payment from the external provider
System enrolls the student in the selected lecture
System confirms enrollment to the student

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: payment is declined by the external provider

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the payment was declined

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: external payment provider is unavailable

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the payment service is unavailable

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: lecture capacity is full preventing enrollment

handling_steps.sentence: System initiates a refund through the external payment provider
System informs the student that enrollment failed and the payment was refunded

success_guarantee: Student is enrolled in the lecture and can access its video content
minimal_guarantee: Card details are never stored by the system
Any payment that does not result in enrollment is refunded
System data remains consistent
issues: [semantic] Remove the refund step or add a requirement that authorizes refunds. [spec.no-scope-creep · easydep convention (hallucination guard) · 우리 판단]

name: Watch Lecture (Playback)
preconditions: Student is authenticated and has access rights to the lecture
trigger: Student selects a lecture to watch

main_scenario.sentence: Student selects the lecture to watch
System streams the lecture video
Student stops playback at any time
System stores the current playback position for the student and lecture

extensions.label: 1a
extensions.condition: a stored playback position exists for the student and the lecture

handling_steps.sentence: System streams the lecture video starting from the stored position

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: the system encounters an error while storing the playback position

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the playback position could not be saved

success_guarantee: The lecture video has been played for the student
The playback position is stored and will be used for future resume
minimal_guarantee: The lecture video was streamed
No partial data is persisted and the system remains operational

name: Upload Lecture Video
preconditions: Lecture for which the video is to be uploaded exists
trigger: Instructor initiates upload of a video file for a lecture

main_scenario.sentence: Instructor provides the video file for the selected lecture
System stores the uploaded video file
System converts the stored video file into the playback format
System makes the converted video available to students for the lecture

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: video conversion fails

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the instructor that conversion failed

success_guarantee: The video is available to students in the required playback format
The video is linked to the lecture
minimal_guarantee: No incomplete video remains accessible
The system continues to operate for other lectures and students

name: View Enrollment Statistics
preconditions: Instructor is authenticated and logged in
trigger: Instructor requests enrollment statistics for their lectures

main_scenario.sentence: Instructor requests enrollment statistics for their lectures
System retrieves the instructor's lectures
System counts the number of students enrolled in each lecture
System presents the enrollment numbers to the instructor

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: Instructor has no lectures

handling_steps.sentence: System informs instructor that no lectures are available

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: Enrollment data cannot be retrieved

handling_steps.sentence: System informs instructor that enrollment numbers could not be retrieved

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: System encounters an error while presenting statistics

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies instructor of a temporary error and suggests retry later

success_guarantee: Instructor has received the number of students enrolled in each of their lectures
minimal_guarantee: No enrollment data is modified
Instructor's authenticated session remains active

name: View Revenue Statistics
preconditions: Instructor is authenticated and authorized to access their own lecture data
trigger: Instructor initiates a request to view revenue statistics for their lectures

main_scenario.sentence: Instructor requests revenue statistics for their lectures
System gathers revenue amounts for each lecture owned by the instructor
System delivers the revenue summary to the instructor

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: System cannot retrieve revenue data due to a technical error

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the instructor that revenue data could not be retrieved

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: The retrieved revenue list is empty

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the instructor that no revenue has been recorded for any lecture

extensions.label: *a
extensions.condition: Instructor's authentication becomes invalid before the use case completes

handling_steps.sentence: System terminates the interaction and prompts the instructor to re-authenticate

success_guarantee: Instructor has received a complete revenue summary for each of their lectures
minimal_guarantee: System does not disclose revenue data belonging to other instructors
System does not modify any revenue records during the interaction

name: Remove Inappropriate Lecture
preconditions: Administrator is authenticated and has authority to remove lectures
The lecture to be removed is currently visible in public view
trigger: Administrator initiates removal of a lecture that violates policy

main_scenario.sentence: Administrator requests removal of the identified lecture
System removes the lecture from public view

extensions.label: 1a
extensions.condition: The identified lecture does not exist or is not currently public

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the administrator that the lecture cannot be found or is already removed

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: System encounters an internal error while removing the lecture

handling_steps.sentence: System records the error
System notifies the administrator of the failure and suggests retry

extensions.label: *a
extensions.condition: Administrator aborts the removal request before system processes it

handling_steps.sentence: System cancels the removal request

success_guarantee: The lecture is no longer visible in public view
System records the removal action for audit
minimal_guarantee: If removal fails, the lecture remains visible in public view
System maintains integrity of lecture data and enforces access controls
issues: [semantic] Remove or rephrase the logging steps that introduce audit capability not required by FR13. [spec.no-scope-creep · easydep convention (hallucination guard) · 우리 판단]
